senses.gloss: 1. इ the third vowel of the alphabet, corresponding to i short, and pronounced as that letter in kill &c.
2. इ ind. an interjection of anger, calling, sorrow, distress, compassion, &c., (g. चादि, Pāṇ. i, 4, 57, &c.)
3. इ base of Nom. and Acc. sg. du. and pl. of the demonstrative pronoun इदम्, ‘this’ or ‘that’
इ [cf. इ॑तर, इतस्, इति, इ॑द्, इदा॑, इयत्, इव, इह: cf. also Lat. id; Goth. ita; Eng. it; Old Germ. iz; Mod. Germ. es.]
4. इ m. N. of Kāmadeva, L.
इ [cf. Gk. εἶ-μι, ἴ-μεν; Lat. e-o, ī-mus, i-ter, &c.; Lith. ei-mì, ‘I go’; Slav. i-dû, ‘I go’, i-ti, ‘to go’; Goth. i-ddja, ‘I went’.]
1. ई the fourth letter of the alphabet, corresponding to इ long, and having the sound of ee in feel.
2. ई m. N. of Kandarpa, the god of love, L.
ई f. (ई or ईस्) N. of Lakṣmī, L. [also in MBh. xii, 11220, according to Nīlak. (who reads पुण्यचञ्चुर् ई)].
3. ई ind. an interjection of pain or anger
a particle implying consciousness or perception, consideration, compassion.
